docs: describe adoption, warn-to-block, versioning and config

Why: a repository adopts this through one caller workflow and one
config file, and everything it can express lives in that config. Without
a reference for each key, rule kind and finding, adopting it means
reading src/.

What changes: README.md covers adoption (the caller workflow, the
config, copying the templates), switching warn to block, versioning and
the workflow inputs, a table of every finding with its rule ID, a
config reference with nido and drawing_board rule examples, local use
(commit template, commit-msg hook), and how to add a fixture.

Evidence: the drawing_board rule examples run as config in
test/core.test.mjs ("README examples").
